course.title: Elements of Solid Mechanics

content.value: The ultimate shear stress of a mild steel flat is $5 0 0 ~ { \mathsf { N } } / { \mathsf { m m } } ^ { 2 } .$ . Calculate the diameter of a hole that can be punched through it without exceeding a compressive stress of 250 MPa, in the punch thickness of the flat being 15 mm. Also, determine the strain in the punch when Young's modulus of its material is $2 \mathsf { x } 1 0 ^ { 5 }$ N/mm<sup>2</sup>.
